user.title: Spider Farmer account
user.description:
Enter the e-mail address of your Spider Farmer app account. A one-time login code will be sent to it.

Note: logging in here signs you out of the Spider Farmer app. Simply log in to the app again afterwards; Home Assistant keeps working.

code.title: Enter login code
code.description: A login code was sent to {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Spider Farmer cloud rejected the stored login for {email}. Submit to receive a new login code by e-mail.

error.send_code_failed: Could not send a login code. Check the e-mail address.
error.invalid_code: The login code is invalid or expired.

abort.wrong_account: This login belongs to a different Spider Farmer account.
abort.no_devices: No devices found in this Spider Farmer account.

command_failed.message: Could not send the command to the Spider Farmer controller. Check that it is online.
